title: Order of bands: Clark, Handy and the WPA, then Celestin
summary: Allen and Trotter straighten out the sequence of Trotter's bands.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Well, first was Robert Clark and then you went on to who? We can get it straight now.
We were Celestan after Robert Clark. I was with Robert Clark. We were Celestan last.

And Celestan was the last band player? The last band. And then Handy and the WPA were in between. That's right. And Huntley-Guardette? Was with us? No, I mean you played some jobs with him too. Oh, I did play jobs with him. Yeah, but that was after Robert Clark. That's right.
